headline: BMW Adjusts Production in San Luis Potosí Due to Electric Transformation
summary: BMW Group said it is adjusting production at its San Luis Potosí plant in Mexico as part of its electric transformation. The company cited intense competition, tariffs and shifting markets.
why: BMW is a German luxury carmaker, and changes to its production footprint affect its cost base, export flows and exposure to the auto industry's transition to electric vehicles.

impacts.name: BMW Group
impacts.why: The production adjustment at its Mexican plant is a company-level operational decision tied to its electric transition.
